newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai UCOM, BICC in optic fibre cable jv.
newsitem.headline: Thai UCOM, BICC in optic fibre cable jv.

text.p: Telecommunications firms UCOM and Biccor have signed an agreement to proceed with plans to make optical fibre telecommunications cables in Thailand, BICC Cables Asia Pacific said on Monday.
The new venture, BICC UCOM Cables Co Ltd will be 35 percent owned by Thai telecom group UCOM, and 65 percent by Biccor, BICC Cables' joint venture with Corning Inc.
BICC Cables said in a statement said Thailand had to import all its fibre optic cables until recently. The BICC group has been a major supplier to UCOM.
The project has already received approval from the Thai Board of Investments and work was under way on a new US$20 million cable manufacturing plant in Rayong, 150 km from Bangkok, it said..
The plant is expected to be completed by the end of 1997.

Six million new telephones lines are due to be installed in Thailand from 1997. Its fibre optics demand is expected to be boosted by the introduction of high capacity trunk switching networks and broadband multimedia services and further network developments to support mobile telephone systems.
